name: Attio MCP
description: Connects agents to the Attio CRM over a hosted OAuth MCP server — search and update people, companies, deals, lists, and notes, with writes gated behind confirmation.

skills.name: Record Search
skills.description: Searches people, companies, and deals across the CRM and returns matching records with their attributes.

skills.name: Record Updates
skills.description: Creates and updates CRM records and list entries, prompting for explicit confirmation before any write lands.

skills.name: Note Management
skills.description: Reads and appends notes on records so agents can log context and meeting outcomes back into the CRM.
